summary: Open files cover each half separately and only for human bone: BoneMechDamage (cyclic tension on femoral cortical bone and trabeculae, CC BY 4.0, 104 MB) and FEMHALS (compression of 94 femoral necks, files not confirmed open). I found no repository dataset pairing tension and crushing on the same fresh specimens, nor any non-human bone, and MatWeb blocks scripted access.
next_step: Compile paired ultimate tensile and compressive strengths of fresh cortical bone from published tables (by species and element), noting hydration and loading rate, then pre-register the ratio test.
obstacles_confirmed: Open files emphasize tensile tests of human femoral bone.
